duplicate_gate.geometry_scope: Four post centers/halves + three goal centers, exact and 1mm; excludes color, seed, entry and robot drift.
duplicate_gate.exclusion_scope: 12 public pilots plus116 historical registered mechanical hashes; no raw outcomes or locked content.
